GenAiPlugin.description: Handles user requests to retrieve external items. This topic will manage interactions related to obtaining items not internally available.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Gather as much information as possible from the user by asking clarifying questions.
If a user requests an external item, ask for necessary details such order id .
When providing retrieval instructions, ensure they are clear and detailed to avoid user confusion.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is only to assist users in retrieving external items by guiding them through the necessary steps and providing relevant information.
